title: Eski Anadolu Türkçesi satır-arası Kur'an tercümesi, Sivas manuscript, leaves 535b-616b (Kütükçü)
author: anonymous (XV century; colophon note «tarih-i tahriri 903», waqf of Kezban Hatun)
edition: Mehmet Kütükçü, Eski Anadolu Türkçesiyle Yazılmış Satır Arası Bir Kur'ân Tercümesi (Gramer - Metin - Tertip - Sözlük) (535b - 616b), master's thesis, Cumhuriyet Üniversitesi, Sosyal Bilimler Enstitüsü, Sivas, September 2005 (supervisor Yrd. Doç. Dr. Burhan Paçacıoğlu)
manuscript: Sivas Kongre ve Etnografya Müzesi E.Y. 84/176 (622 leaves; this edition: 535b-616b); the other published part of the same manuscript is leaves 105b-170b (Delice, MEAL-EAT-SIVAS-DELICE)
licence: scholarly edition; archive.org third-party upload; local research use

acquisition.note: OCR text (djvu.txt) of an archive.org third-party upload; no PDF kept.

coverage: 54-114 (1344/1390 ayat of the edition's range 54:1-114:6; the manuscript itself lacks 58:22, 59:1-2a)
notes: Partial: leaves 535b-616b of the Sivas manuscript only (surahs 54-114). 1344 of 1390 verses present; 46 missing in 20 surahs (listed in ingestion.missing: the manuscript's own lacunae 58:22 and 59:1-2, and verses lost to the OCR, whose first letters of many lines are missing in surahs 69-114). Folio ids sit in `page`; manuscript line numbers /k/ stay in the text of surahs 69-114. Text is OCR as is, not corrected. scholarly edition; archive.org third-party upload; local research use

ingestion.edition_range: folios 535b-616b = surahs 54:1 to 114 (the manuscript lacks 58:22, 59:1 and half of 59:2)
